classification.difficultyReason: Select and justify suitable data-collection techniques for three different populations.

content.prompt: Here are some questions to initiate a discussion on techniques for collecting data.

children.label: a
children.prompt: What proportion of Australian households recorded a television program during the past week?

answer.short: Sample answer: Survey a representative sample of Australian households about the past week and calculate the proportion that recorded a television program.
answer.worked: Randomly select households from different parts of Australia. Ask each household the same question about whether it recorded a television program during the past week. Estimate the population proportion using $\dfrac{\text{households answering yes}}{\text{households responding}}$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: What percentage of a large shipment of components of a machine can stand up to a stress test?

answer.short: Sample answer: Stress-test a random sample from throughout the shipment and calculate the percentage that pass.
answer.worked: Choose components randomly from different parts of the shipment and apply the same stress test to each. Estimate the percentage that withstand the test using $\dfrac{\text{number passing}}{\text{number tested}}\times100\%$. Sampling is particularly useful if testing damages the components.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Is a particular component of a particular model of car safe? One hundred and fifty thousand of the cars have been distributed worldwide.

answer.short: Sample answer: Test components from a representative sample of the cars and examine worldwide reports of component failures.
answer.worked: Plan tests that measure whether the component meets the required safety standard. Select cars from different production batches and countries, test their components under the same conditions, and collect records of reported failures. Use both sets of evidence to assess safety; a sample with no failures does not establish that every component is safe.
